subject: Quick recap + one question on priority for Chartwell
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@chartwell.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@chartanalytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + one question on priority for Chartwell

Hi Alex —

Great to meet you and Priya on the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned:

• What we heard: Chartwell wants lower-latency, cost-predictable embedding and reranking for your search pipeline (currently on CPU infra).
• Proposed pilot: 2-week proof-of-concept on a subset of queries (up to 5M tokens), Redwood-hosted, metrics capture for latency and cost per-request.
• Success criteria: 90th percentile latency under 150ms, >10% reduction in cost-per-query vs. baseline, no observable accuracy regression on the test suite you shared.

Attachments: redwood-demo-slides.pdf (15 slides) — demo notes + performance anchors. I also drafted an initial SOW (sow-draft-v1.docx) that outlines scope and responsibilities.

Immediate ask: is this pilot still a top priority for you/Chartwell for Q3/Q4? If yes, I can:
  1) lock dates for a pilot kickoff the week of Aug 23,
  2) send an updated SOW for review, and
  3) arrange a 30-min tech sync with our solutions engineer (Ben) to scope test data and access.

If not a priority, totally understood — a quick reply with timing (e.g., Q4 or next year) would help us not keep the SOW in draft.

Thanks again —
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Hey Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the SOW. The team liked the approach. A couple quick notes:

• Priority: this is a potential Q4 initiative but I need to validate budget with finance — likely early Sept decision window.
• Data residency: can Redwood guarantee EU data storage for the pilot if needed (we have some EU-hosted clients)?

I’m cc’ing Priya (product) — she’ll help with the test-set selection.

I’ll loop back when I have a budget signal.

Cheers,
Alex
Head of Search, Chartwell.ai
alex@chartwell.ai

Alex —

Quick follow-up on this thread — I wanted to make it easy to move forward if you have a budget green-light in September. A couple helpful notes: 

• EU data: yes — we can run the pilot in an EU region and provide customer-managed encryption keys. Ben (cc’d) can share a short tech note on the setup and estimated effort.
• SOW: I attached a marked-up SOW (sow-draft-v1.docx) that narrows the pilot to 2 weeks and lists responsibilities for data access and evaluation metrics.

If helpful, I can schedule a 20-minute session the week of Aug 23 to align on test data and finalize the SOW. Is either Aug 24 or 25 open for you? If timing has shifted, a quick reply with the new quarter helps us prioritize.

Thanks —
Jasmine
